title: Check-ups & consultations
short: A place to begin when you have questions about your teeth, gums or mouth.
detail: Start with a conversation about your concerns and an assessment of your oral health. You do not need to choose a procedure before meeting a dentist.
alt: Illustrative image: a dentist discussing a dental chart on a tablet with a patient
wa: Hi AJ Dental, I would like to book a dental check-up and consultation. Please let me know the available slots.
questions: What should I bring to the appointment?
Which concerns should we look at first?
What would the next step involve?

title: Teeth cleaning & polishing
short: Professional cleaning, and looking after your teeth between visits.
detail: If you would like to enquire about professional teeth cleaning and polishing, book a visit and ask the dentist about your gum health and the care that may be appropriate for you.
alt: Illustrative image: professional teeth cleaning in progress
wa: Hi AJ Dental, I would like to book an appointment for teeth cleaning and polishing. Please let me know the available slots.
questions: Would cleaning be appropriate for me now?
What should I expect at the visit?
How should I look after my teeth afterwards?

title: Oral-health checks
short: Questions about your mouth, gums or changes you have noticed.
detail: A consultation is a sensible starting point for questions about your mouth or gums. Tell us about any changes you have noticed when you visit; we can’t diagnose from a website.
alt: Illustrative image: a dentist examining a patient’s teeth with a dental mirror
wa: Hi AJ Dental, I would like to book an appointment to discuss an oral health concern. Please let me know the available slots.
questions: What should I tell the dentist about my concern?
Are any further checks or referrals appropriate?
When should I come back for a review?

title: Dental fillings
short: Discuss options when a tooth needs repair.
detail: If a tooth needs repair, an assessment helps clarify the available options. Ask us what is suitable, what the treatment would involve and how to care for the tooth afterwards.
alt: Illustrative image: a tooth-coloured filling being placed and cured
wa: Hi AJ Dental, I would like to book an appointment about a dental filling. Please let me know the available slots.
questions: What are the repair options for this tooth?
What would treatment involve?
What follow-up or aftercare would I need?

title: Root canal care
short: Explore the next step when a tooth needs attention on the inside.
detail: If you have a question about root canal treatment or a tooth that is troubling you, start with an assessment. We can discuss the concern with you and which options may be suitable.
alt: Illustrative image: root canal treatment using a dental microscope
wa: Hi AJ Dental, I would like to book an appointment about root canal treatment. Please let me know the available slots.
questions: Is this treatment appropriate for my tooth?
What would the visits involve?
What should I ask about recovery and follow-up?

title: Dental implants
short: A conversation about replacing a missing tooth.
detail: If you are considering a dental implant, ask about an assessment and the options for replacing your missing tooth. We’ll discuss suitability, the treatment plan and our current availability with you at your consultation.
alt: Illustrative image: a dentist explaining a dental implant model to a patient
wa: Hi AJ Dental, I would like to enquire about dental implants for a missing tooth. Please let me know the available slots for a consultation.
questions: What options are appropriate in my situation?
Which practitioner would assess and treat me?
What would the treatment and follow-up involve?

title: Dentures & bridges
short: Discuss other approaches to replacing missing teeth.
detail: There may be different ways to replace a missing tooth or several teeth. Use a consultation to ask about the options, their suitability and what to expect over time.
alt: Illustrative image: ceramic bridge work being prepared on a dental model
wa: Hi AJ Dental, I would like to book an appointment about dentures or a bridge. Please let me know the available slots.
questions: Which options could be considered?
What is involved in making and fitting them?
How would I care for them afterwards?

title: Tooth removal
short: Ask about assessment, what to expect and aftercare.
detail: If you have been advised to consider removing a tooth, discuss the assessment, options and aftercare with us. This website is not a substitute for that individual conversation.
alt: Illustrative image: a dentist explaining a wisdom tooth on a jaw model before treatment
wa: Hi AJ Dental, I would like to book an appointment about tooth removal. Please let me know the available slots.
questions: Is removal the right next step for this tooth?
What should I expect at the appointment?
What aftercare and follow-up should I plan for?

title: Braces & teeth alignment
short: Bring your questions about alignment or your bite.
detail: If you are considering orthodontic care, start with a consultation about your teeth alignment and bite. Ask which options may be appropriate and what the process would involve.
alt: Illustrative image: a smiling patient wearing braces
wa: Hi AJ Dental, I would like to book an orthodontic consultation about braces and teeth alignment. Please let me know the available slots.
questions: What alignment options could suit me?
How are the treatment and follow-up planned?
What should I understand before deciding?

title: Teeth whitening
short: Explore your options for a brighter-looking smile.
detail: Before choosing whitening, ask about an assessment, suitability and current treatment options. Individual results vary, and we’ll happily go through your questions with you.
alt: Illustrative image: teeth whitening consultation with a shade guide
wa: Hi AJ Dental, I would like to enquire about teeth whitening. Please let me know the available slots for a consultation.
questions: Is whitening appropriate for my teeth?
What should I expect from the options available?
How do I look after my teeth afterwards?

title: Smile design & cosmetic dentistry
short: Discuss a chipped tooth, a small gap or a change you are considering.
detail: A smile-design or cosmetic dental consultation can start with what you would like to discuss about your smile. Ask about the options, their limitations and the steps involved before choosing a procedure.
alt: Illustrative image: a smile design consultation with a digital preview on a tablet
wa: Hi AJ Dental, I would like to book a smile design / cosmetic dentistry consultation. Please let me know the available slots.
questions: Which options could address my concern?
What are the limitations of those options?
What should I know before deciding?
